audit.title: Independent code review — blind release audit
audit.remediationSummary: All P0/P1 findings (R12-001, R12-002, R12-003) remediated and verified in PR #397 and PR #398. P2/P3 findings deferred with assigned owners and rationales.

findings.title: SSRF and Local File Inclusion in ImageDownloader
findings.claim: Multimodal image downloading allows arbitrary URL fetching without protocol validation or IP address filtering.
findings.risk: Local file exfiltration (e.g. file:///etc/passwd) and cloud metadata token theft (http://169.254.169.254/) via multimodal prompt injection.
findings.recommendation: Route image retrieval through an explicit governed outbound-fetch boundary with HTTP/HTTPS scheme enforcement, redirect validation/deny-by-default semantics, prohibited-address filtering (private RFC 1918, loopback 127.0.0.0/8, link-local 169.254.0.0/16, IPv6) on every resolution and request attempt, and connected-peer validation where transport capabilities permit. Reuse or factor TramAI's established outbound network governance principles (e.g. OutboundNetworkPolicy / injected image fetch transport abstraction) rather than creating a weaker, ad-hoc DNS precheck.
findings.closureNotes: Remediated via OutboundAddressSecurity URL scheme/IP address validation and ImageDownloader connection lifecycle management.

findings.title: Raw SQLException and SQL Diagnostic Leakage in JDBC Stores
findings.claim: JDBC store operations rethrow raw java.sql.SQLException or propagate unredacted SQL diagnostics.
findings.risk: Table schemas, database query structures, and connection failure diagnostics leak up the stack to callers.
findings.reproduction: Trigger a constraint violation or closed connection during store operation and inspect unmapped SQLException.
findings.recommendation: Map all SQLException instances into typed PersistenceException with sanitized diagnostics.
findings.closureNotes: Remediated via JdbcSafeOperation sanitized database exception mapping across all JDBC store implementations.

findings.title: Gradle Strict Task Dependency Validation Failures
findings.claim: verify060Architecture encounters implicit task dependency validation errors under Gradle 9.0.0.
findings.risk: CI or clean daemon verification fails under Gradle 9.0 strict execution rules (--warning-mode=fail).
findings.reproduction: env -u TRAMAI_PUBLISH_RELEASE_URL ./gradlew verify060Architecture --warning-mode=fail --no-daemon (fails on :examples:kotlin-consumer-smoke:verifyKotlinConsumerCompatibility using output of :examples:kotlin-consumer-smoke:compileKotlin without dependency declaration).
findings.recommendation: Scope ConsumerSmokeCompileTask.sources to exact source files or declare explicit task dependencies (dependsOn / mustRunAfter) on compileKotlin.
findings.closureNotes: Remediated via MaintainabilityBaselinePlugin ConsumerSmokeCompileTask explicit source file inputs.

findings.title: Permissive Default Policy Engine in EngineComponentFactory
findings.claim: Defaults to LegacyPermissivePolicyEngine when no policy engine is configured.
findings.rationale: Retained for 0.4.x standalone backwards compatibility; 0.6.0 documentation directs users to governedPolicyFor.
findings.remediationPlan: Mark LegacyPermissivePolicyEngine as @Deprecated with removal in 1.0.0.

findings.title: Hardcoded Allow at BEFORE_TOOL_RESULT_REINJECTION
findings.risk: Tool results cannot be selectively blocked by policy rules before reaching LLM provider.
findings.rationale: DLP filters sanitize tool results before provider ingestion, providing defense-in-depth.
findings.remediationPlan: Extend PolicyEngine SPI to evaluate reinjection policies in 0.7.0.

findings.title: Unredacted Exception Recording in OpenTelemetry Spans
findings.claim: span.recordException is invoked with raw throwable instances.
findings.risk: Sensitive tokens in exception messages could be exported to telemetry collectors.
findings.rationale: Standard OTel practice; sensitive headers and payloads are already masked at HTTP layer.
findings.remediationPlan: Pass exception messages through Redactor.sanitize before recording.

findings.title: Weak Fallback Assertion in ProviderTck for Vision/Structured Content
findings.claim: ProviderTck falls back to assertNotNull when expectedContent is null.
findings.risk: A provider returning empty or corrupted payload could satisfy the TCK.
findings.rationale: All official providers have dedicated provider-level tests asserting exact response content.
findings.remediationPlan: Add strict non-empty content assertions in ProviderTck.

findings.title: Vacuous Ciphertext Assertions in JdbcApprovalContinuationStoreTest
findings.claim: Test uses assertNotNull on encrypted columns rather than validating entropy or ciphertext format.
findings.risk: Storage of plaintext or corrupt ciphertext could pass the column assertion.
findings.rationale: Roundtrip decryption is asserted in the same test suite.
findings.remediationPlan: Assert that raw column content does not contain plaintext data.

findings.title: Shell Step Command Policy Evaluates Binary Path Only
findings.claim: Policy evaluation checks only the executable binary name without inspecting command-line flags.
findings.risk: Flag-level granularity is unsupported in shell authorization policies.
findings.rationale: Command authorization operates fail-closed at the executable binary boundary (unallowlisted binaries are rejected). Granular regex/argument inspection is an expressiveness enhancement for advanced sandboxing rather than a core release correctness requirement for 0.6.0.
findings.recommendation: Support argument-aware regex policies for shell step authorization.

findings.title: Manifest Test Coupled to Whitespace-Free JSON Substring
findings.claim: Tests assert exact raw string matches instead of parsing JSON AST.
findings.risk: Refactoring JSON serialization formatting breaks test without behavioral regression.
findings.rationale: The test exercises StoreManifestV1 serialization determinism against a fixed canonical representation. While AST-based comparison would be more resilient to formatting changes, the current test is completely green and does not indicate any runtime defect.
findings.recommendation: Use JSON structure comparison in manifest serialization tests.

findings.title: Misleading Test Class Name ShutdownHookTest
findings.claim: Tests programmatic worker shutdown rather than JVM shutdown hooks.
findings.risk: Misleading test naming confuses contributors auditing JVM hook registration.
findings.rationale: The test accurately exercises WorkerShutdownCoordinator graceful shutdown and job draining. The class name ShutdownHookTest is a historical artifact from earlier design iterations and does not affect test execution, coverage, or runtime behavior.

findings.title: Line Number Drifts in adding-a-provider.md
findings.claim: Code reference line numbers have drifted slightly from master source.
findings.risk: Minor contributor friction when locating code references.
findings.rationale: The change guide accurately describes the ModelProvider SPI, module catalog wiring, and ProviderTck enrollment. The line-number drifts of 1–5 lines in code pointers do not prevent contributors from finding the referenced members or implementing new providers.
findings.recommendation: Update line number references in change guide.

findings.claim: Example snippet uses slightly outdated package namespace.
findings.risk: Minor contributor friction when copying example snippet.
findings.rationale: The constraint compilation pipeline, validator stages, and TCK failure taxonomy are correctly detailed. The minor package path drift in the descriptive text is easily disambiguated by IDE auto-import.
findings.recommendation: Update package name in example snippet.
